def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Find uniform 3x3 blocks and their colors.
    crosses=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w-2):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r+1,c+1,color) in seen: continue
            if all(grid[i][j]==color for i in range(r,r+3) for j in range(c,c+3)):
                center=(r+1,c+1,color)
                if center not in seen:
                    seen.add(center); crosses.append(center)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    owners={}
    for cr,cc,color in crosses:
        for j in range(w): owners.setdefault((cr,j),set()).add(color)
        for i in range(h): owners.setdefault((i,cc),set()).add(color)
    for (r,c),colors in owners.items():
        out[r][c] = next(iter(colors)) if len(colors)==1 else 0
    return out
